cases.description: A data block whose fence is not closed is a syntax error at its section: CommonMark would run it to the end of the file, and YAML would read the heading after it as a comment, so a section would vanish silently (§5.3, decision P2).
An anchor element is recognized only among a heading's direct children; one inside emphasis is anchor-element-invalid, since removing it would leave the title *A * (§6.2, decision P4).
An unknown data marker as the first block of a record without a title heading is feature-unsupported, not prose, so a newer kind of data block is detected (§5.3, decision P6).
The same right after a data block, at the section (§5.3, decision P6).
A json data block holding only white space gives no fields, as an empty block does, rather than being empty JSON (§5.3, decision P7).
